events.title: FUJIFILM Q4 Earnings & Revenues Up Y/Y on Solid Segmental Performance
events.body: FUJIY posted record Q4 revenue and profit as healthcare, semiconductor materials and imaging demand lifted results and fueled upbeat exercice 2026 outlook.

events.title: Trade Desk Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Up Y/Y, Stock Down
events.body: TTD beat revenue estimates as AI launches, strategic partnerships and strong CTV growth drove momentum despite an EPS miss.

events.title: SONY's Q4 Earnings Plunge Y/Y Despite Healthy Revenues, G&NS Weakens
events.body: Sony T4 exercice 2025 revenues jump 8% to 3,036.4B yen, but GAAP EPS fall to 13.93 yen as gaming and "All Other" weighed on results.

events.title: Watts Water's Q1 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Increase Y/Y
events.body: WTS posted record Q1 sales and earnings as data center demand, pricing and productivity gains fueled margin expansion.
